settlement_read.source_conflict_reason: The source result conflicts with a manual override and awaits an operator decision.
settlement_read.unknown_time_reason: The event or closing time could not be read reliably.
settlement_read.social_market_not_closed: The Social Market closing time has not passed yet.
settlement_read.safety_buffer: Manual settlement waits for the 120-minute safety buffer after the event starts.
settlement_read.ready_reason: The time check passed; manual WON / LOST / VOID may be applied.
settlement_read.tennis_policy_body: Do not apply WON/LOST before verifying the official final result source. For a normally completed match, apply WON when the selected player won and LOST when the selected player lost.
settlement_read.tennis_policy_retirement: Use VOID/manual review for retirement, walkover, abandoned/suspended play, player replacement, or withdrawal.
settlement_read.tennis_policy_postponed: Hold settlement for postponed matches; do not finalize them.
settlement_read.tennis_policy_reason: The reason must state the official result source, result status, and selected-player outcome.
settlement_read.tennis_policy_automatic: Automatic settlement is disabled for Tennis H2H V1.
settlement_read.chess_manual_ready: A controlled recurring Chess reservation closes with a normal operator decision. WON uses stored odds; if odds are missing, the operator enters the payout.
settlement_read.chess_manual_waiting: The reservation remains visible; settlement actions stay disabled until it becomes eligible.
settlement_read.stored_odds_missing: Stored odds are missing; enter the payout amount for WON.
settlement_read.lost_effect: LOST creates no additional credit or refund.
settlement_read.void_effect: VOID refunds the stake exactly once.
settlement_read.chess_row_visible: The row remains visible with a Chess badge so the operator does not miss it.
settlement_read.chess_ready_reason: The Chess reservation is operator-managed; a WON / LOST / VOID decision may be applied.

settlement_exceptions.missing_settlement_reason: Accepted bets exist, but settlement is still not closed after the event.
settlement_exceptions.settlement_mismatch_reason: Accepted bet and closed settlement counts do not match (:closed/:accepted).
settlement_exceptions.mixed_precedence_reason: Manual override and source-applied settlement are both present.
settlement_exceptions.missing_finance_link_reason: A wallet effect exists without a linked finance transaction.
settlement_exceptions.mixed_states_reason: The same event contains both closed and pending/review settlements.
settlement_exceptions.winner_without_payout: A winning settlement exists, but no payout total is visible.
settlement_exceptions.payout_without_winner: A payout total exists, but no winner count is visible.
settlement_exceptions.incomplete_closed_distribution: The closed settlement distribution looks incomplete; some outcomes are missing from the aggregate.
settlement_exceptions.aggregate_review: The settlement payout or winner aggregate needs review.
settlement_exceptions.unresolved_ingest: The source-ingest chain contains unresolved or ambiguous records.
settlement_exceptions.precedence_review: The settlement precedence state remains review_required.
settlement_exceptions.rows_in_review: Settlement rows are waiting in review.
settlement_exceptions.source_conflict: A source-conflict signal requires operator review.
settlement_exceptions.neutral_review: The settlement chain has an informational signal that requires operator review.
